## Checklist

- [ ] `make ci` passes locally (lint, check, tests)
- [ ] New behaviour has a test (unit for rules/logic, integration for scenes)
- [ ] Docs updated if commands, structure, or rules changed
- [ ] Screenshot / recording attached for visual changes
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, ...)
